scope: Ten developer-labelled attribution/support/boundary cases, twice each; explicit per-span and criterion expectations. Focused semantic regression, not independent blind evaluation.
stop_rule: Fixed 20-candidate schedule; extraction then semantic review, at most one source-existence recheck. Stop on declared provider configuration failures. No output repair, network retry or mid-batch relabelling.
review_basis: Expected statuses fixed from declared Observation boundaries before any model call; labels and case ids are never passed to the model.
comparison_basis: New explicit per-claim axis labels and all criterion expectations, frozen before calls. Candidate-report attribution is not evidence of source truth. Do not compare headline counts directly with differently labelled earlier fixtures.

candidate.description: The submitted route first divides the price for six kilograms by six and then scales the resulting per-kilogram figure to fifteen kilograms. The equality 42 / 6 = 8 is arithmetically false: that quotient is 7. The stated total, 120 yuan, does not answer the task correctly; fifteen kilograms at seven yuan per kilogram cost 105 yuan. The learner reported uncertainty about division and requested an explanation.

work.task: 6kg apples cost 42 yuan. What do 15kg cost?
work.text:
42 / 6 = 8; 8 * 15 = 120; Answer = 120
The learner wrote: "I am unsure about division. Please explain."

expected_claim_axes.text: The learner reported uncertainty about division and requested an explanation.
